body: In this episode, Pippa and Neil talk about who usually does the cleaning, cooking and washing at home.
在这期节目里，Pippa 和 Neil 聊了家里谁通常负责打扫、做饭和洗衣。
They look at research showing that women around the world still spend far more time on unpaid housework than men do.
他们看了一项研究：全球范围内，女性花在家务这种无酬劳动上的时间，仍远多于男性。
You will learn useful words and phrases to describe household chores and the idea of 'pulling your weight'.
你会学到形容家务、以及'分担责任'这个意思的实用词汇和短语。
tips: 尽自己的本分、分担责任

articles.en: How do climate scientists make predictions?
articles.zh: 气候科学家怎么做预测？
body: Phil and Pippa explain how scientists use computer models to picture what Earth's climate may look like in the future.
Phil 和 Pippa 解释了科学家如何借助计算机模型，描绘地球气候未来的可能面貌。
They compare a 'prediction' with a 'projection', and discuss why clouds can both cool and warm the planet.
他们比较了'预测'与'推演'的区别，并讨论了云为何既能给地球降温、也能让它升温。
You will learn clear vocabulary about weather, models and the environment that appears in climate news.
你会学到关于天气、模型和环境、常出现在气候新闻里的清晰词汇。
Pippa and Neil discuss a new kind of sports event where athletes are allowed to use performance-enhancing drugs.
Pippa 和 Neil 讨论了一种新型体育赛事：运动员被允许使用提升表现的药物。
They ask whether this idea is fairer, safer or simply more honest about what already happens in sport.
他们探讨这个想法是否更公平、更安全，或只是更坦白地说出了体育界已有的事。
You will learn vocabulary about sport, rules and health that helps you talk about this debate in English.
你会学到关于体育、规则和健康的词汇，帮你用英语聊这场争论。

articles.zh: 足球运动员的大脑里有什么？
body: This episode looks at how footballers stay calm and make quick decisions during high-pressure moments like penalties.
这期节目探讨：足球运动员在罚点球这类高压时刻，怎样保持冷静、快速做决定。
Phil and Pippa talk with a brain scientist about focus, training and the mental side of the game.
Phil 和 Pippa 与一位脑科学家聊了专注力、训练，以及这项运动中心理层面的重要性。
You will learn everyday words about sport, the mind and concentration that are useful in many conversations.
你会学到关于运动、心智和专注力的日常词汇，在很多对话里都用得上。
Phil and Becca talk about emails that sound impolite or cold, and why they can upset the people who receive them.
Phil 和 Becca 聊了那些听起来没礼貌或冷淡的邮件，以及它们为何会让收件人不快。
They share simple ways to write more friendly and clear messages at work or in daily life.
他们分享了在工作或日常生活中，写出更友好、更清晰信息的简单方法。
You will learn polite phrases and expressions that help you communicate without sounding rude.
你会学到有礼貌的短语和表达，帮你沟通时不再显得冒犯。
